score_definition: For 24 exact-answer probes, score 1 only when case-folded, whitespace-collapsed model output equals the expected answer after stripping outer quotes and one trailing period; otherwise 0. For eight invariant rewrites, score 1 only when every listed case-sensitive required marker occurs and no listed forbidden marker occurs; otherwise 0. Greedy temperature-zero generation, identical no-thinking chat-template token IDs, at most 48 output tokens per task, 96 per stopping case, 32 per resource case. Compare the unweighted mean over all 32 tasks. Stopping violations count non-stop terminal reasons; visible reasoning means a literal think/analysis marker in output. These are technical probes, not writing-quality ratings.
